tasks.task: Write an edit decision list from a transcript

items.when: Before the list, to cut a long interview to its few strong passages and their order
When you have a timed transcript and need every keep, cut and tighten with a reason
When the recording is full of pauses, fillers and retakes that need a timed cut list
When everything seems worth keeping, to pick the one effect and cut what weakens it
Before the list goes out, to check no cut changes what the speaker meant

tasks.task: Get a timed transcript from a recording

items.when: When the client sends audio or video with no transcript and speakers must be labelled
When you need word-level timing for cuts and captions, not just the words
When the recording is not in English or needs an English translation
When the source is already on YouTube and you only have the link
When names and product terms may be misheard, to catch each one spelt two ways

tasks.task: Tighten a long recording to a target length

items.when: When you need a quick first-pass cut list to hit a set length before the full edit list
When easy time can be won first by cutting pauses, fillers and retakes
When the cut hits the length but drags, to question each choice and test it again
When answers were shortened, to check each one still says what the speaker meant

tasks.task: Find and plan short clips with hooks

items.when: When a long recording must yield vertical clips with in and out points and hook text
When you want a second pick of the best five moments, each with a new first line
When a clip's opening is weak, to get ten hooks checked for length and first shot
When the client wants draft clips cut and captioned by a tool for you to review
When a clip starts slowly, to review whether the first seconds pay off the title
Before a clip is posted, to check the cut-down version does not twist the point

tasks.task: Write caption files for a video or its clips

items.when: When each clip needs an accurate SRT file with short lines and times from its in point
When captions are burned in, to see them timed in the brand font with a fault list
When on-screen words must sit clear of the app's buttons and captions
When there is no timed transcript to build the captions from
Before delivery, to catch typos and names spelt two ways across caption files

tasks.task: Write B-roll, pacing, graphics and music cue notes

items.when: When the editor needs cues tied to timecodes, using only footage and music the client has
When voice, music, effects and fades need a timed plan with mix checks
When a section is graphics only and needs an exact build plan and text table
When the cut is flat, to decide what viewers know and map the visual beats

tasks.task: Write chapters, description and show notes

items.when: When a finished long video needs chapters and a description from what was actually said
When chapters are written along with the cue notes for the same cut
When chapters do not show on the video, to check them against YouTube's rules
When the description should also target searches, to compare a search-led version
When the recording is a podcast and needs a summary, key points and links mentioned

tasks.task: Take a long recording to a finished cut and clips

items.when: When the client wants a tightened version, clips, captions and chapters from one recording
When you start from raw audio, to compare a run that cleans speech first
When the client wants exactly five shorts with new first lines from a transcript
When the client will apply the cuts by editing the transcript themselves
Before the cut and clips go to the client or the speaker

tasks.task: Run a weekly batch of clips from new recordings

items.when: Each week, when new recordings arrive and a set of clips is due
When each recording needs its moments picked and planned as vertical clips
When last month's results are in, to pick which pieces deserve more clips
When the client also wants posts and emails made from the same recording

tasks.task: Turn an approved edit list into steps for the editing tool

items.when: When the edit list is approved and the client edits in Descript, CapCut or similar
When the client is new to their app and needs a second-by-second plan with export settings
When the client edits on a phone and you must know what the app can do
When the client edits by transcript and the steps must match that way of working

tasks.task: Plan camera angles for a multicam podcast or interview

items.when: When two or more cameras were used and the editor needs to know which angle when
Before the angle plan, to fix what stays in the cut and where each speaker talks
When the vertical clips need their own angle and crop for each speaker

tasks.task: Plan a response to a copyright claim or muted video

items.when: When a video has a Content ID claim or is muted or blocked and the client wants options
When it is unclear how serious the claim is, to list the factors before replying
When the simplest fix is to swap the claimed track for music made for the client
When someone has re-uploaded the client's video and a notice may be needed

tasks.task: Plan the edit of a Reel, TikTok or Short from clips

items.when: When you have clips and the post's idea and need a timed cut list, captions and a cover
When raw footage needs a scene-by-scene plan the client approves before the render
When the first line is undecided, to get ten openings and the two to try first
When the client wants one repeatable cover style for every Reel
When a cut is drafted, to check captions, sound and export and rank the fixes

tasks.task: Cut and caption a video ad

items.when: When you have the clips and script and need a timed cut list, caption windows and exports
When the ad needs the cut, brand-font captions and a launch check in one run
When the opening is weak, to get three spoken openings with a storyboard to compare
When the ad sells too early, to score the move from hook to offer and tighten it
When past ads have results, to grade the new opening against what won before

tasks.task: Clean up and finish the audio

items.when: When speech is buried under background noise or music
When the mix needs a timed plan for voice, music, effects and fades
When a line needs a voice-over, a sound effect or a music bed made
Before export, to measure loudness, noise and speech quality

tasks.task: Plan the title, thumbnail and cover for a video

items.when: When a video needs several title and thumbnail pairs to test against each other
When short clips need a cover style that repeats across the feed
When there is a list of titles, to read each alone and keep the best three
Before upload, to check title length and that the thumbnail does not repeat it

tasks.task: Read retention data and fix where viewers leave

items.when: When you have a retention export, to see where viewers leave and what was said then
When the next video should fix both the click and the first drop in one plan
When the fix is pacing, to rewrite the cues at the points where viewers dropped
When viewers leave in the first minute and the opening does not pay off the title

tasks.task: Shape an interview or testimonial into a story

items.when: When a long interview must be cut to its strongest passages in a usable order
When the order follows the recording, to try an order that puts the viewer in the seat
When customer quotes must become a short video script with a source for every line
When the piece lists facts but nothing changes for the person on screen
When answers were reordered or joined, to check nobody seems to say what they did not

tasks.task: Make subtitles or dubs in other languages

items.when: When the video needs versions in other languages that keep each speaker's voice
When a scripted voice-over needs dubbed versions and subtitles for each language
When translated lines must be re-timed and kept short enough to read
When the client wants to caption and translate in a browser with no install

tasks.task: Fill a gap in the cut with AI or stock footage

items.when: Before making anything, to choose between generating, composing or editing footage
When a missing shot will be generated and needs a prompt and fixes for failed clips
When you need a short generated clip or an edit to footage you already have
When generated clips come back wrong, to turn each fault into a rule for the retry

always.when: When on-screen text or a description states a number or claim nobody said on tape

helpers.when: When the job needs a script, a shoot plan or new footage, not only an edit
When the recording is a podcast that also needs audio release, show notes and guests handled
When titles, thumbnails and topics must fit a channel plan and its numbers
When the clips need captions for the post, a schedule and replies
When thumbnails, covers, lower thirds or title cards need designing
When subtitles in another language must be checked by someone who knows it well

gaps: No library item writes a timecoded edit decision list in a format an editing tool can import; only the kit skill covers it
No library item plans a multicam edit: which angle to use when, for the long cut and for vertical clips
No library item builds a B-roll list from a transcript or finds stock footage the client may use
No library item plans a vertical reframe: crop, speaker tracking and safe areas for 9:16 from 16:9
No library item sets export settings per platform: size, frame rate, bitrate, loudness and file names
No library item checks caption quality: reading speed, line length, line breaks and timing against speech
No library item covers colour correction, a grade look or matching shots from two cameras
No library item checks music and footage licences or helps answer a Content ID claim; only the kit prompt does
No library item gives step-by-step handoff for Premiere or DaVinci Resolve; tool guides cover Descript, CapCut and VEED only
No library item manages client review rounds and timecoded revision notes
